name: config-ts-app-tanstack
title: Typescript Config TanStack SolidJs Application
description: A typescript config for TanStack SolidJs applications.

files.content:
{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/tsconfig",
  "display": "SolidJs Tanstack App TSConfig",
  "extends": "./tsconfig.base.json",
  "compilerOptions": {
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "Bundler",
    "jsx": "preserve",
    "jsxImportSource": "solid-js",
    "lib": ["DOM", "DOM.Iterable", "ES2022"],
    "noEmit": true,
    "allowJs": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "types": ["@types/node", "vite/client"]
  },
  "exclude": [
    "node_modules",
    "build",
    "dist",
    "scripts",
    "public",
    ".wrangler",
    ".vinxi",
    ".vercel",
    ".nitro",
    ".output",
    ".tanstack",
    ".tmp"
  ]
}
